3175-4247-7424.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

215-3151-4742.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Elves.
215-3151-4742.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Elvish Archdruid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Elvish Archdruid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2173-5220-6505-6559.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-3129-4762-7267.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Primal Vigor and Michelangelo.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2034-2528-5088-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
2034-2528-5088-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Channel the Suns with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Channel the Suns from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Channel the Suns.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 15.

1806-2060-4050-4772-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Doubling Season.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

372-813-7339.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-813-7339.description:
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Scholar of the Ages and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Scholar of the Ages trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Go Ninja Go from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Scholar of the Ages and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

339-677-2511-7175.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2034-3490-4369-6096.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2034-3490-4369-6096.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, General Kreat triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-4211-4894.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Tormod's Crypt.
Cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Breaching Hippocamp.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

141-4050-6817.description:
Cast Presumed Dead by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Presumed Dead, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Presumed Dead.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3197-6797-6872.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
3197-6797-6872.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

585-4508-4772-5880.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

2510-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
2510-5078-6650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

2921-3497-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2921-3497-4484-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
2921-3497-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2921-3497-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

204-392-1858-2056-6633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-392-1858-2056-6633.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

560-2425-4050-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2425-4050-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier, adding two mana of any color.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Smothering Abomination triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

856-1808-3967-4321.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, creating a Clue and Food token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Eloise's second ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

803-1238-2351-5467-5686.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

101-4377-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons and Vampire Charmseeker each turn.
101-4377-6122.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Vampire Charmseeker by paying its mana cost.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Vampire Charmseeker from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2557-4871-6074.description:
During your upkeep, activate Nim Devourer by paying {B}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then sacrificing it.
When Nim Devourer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact Creature with Mana Cost X and Toughness 0

218-1295-1368-4264--39.notablePrerequisites: Altered Ego is a copy of Diligent Excavator.
218-1295-1368-4264--39.description:
Cast the artifact creature from your hand by paying {0}.
Diligent Excavator and Altered Ego trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
The artifact creature enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Cast the artifact creature from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling any three cards from your graveyard, except Thassa's Oracle if it is in your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2 until you have an empty library.
If Thassa's Oracle is in your hand, cast it by paying {U}{U}.
Otherwise, cast Thassa's Oracle  from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

1669-2034-3000-4679.notablePrerequisites:
Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one Aura.
1669-2034-3000-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of an Aura you control and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token, then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thaumatog's second ability by sacrificing the Aura token, giving Thaumatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

252-4312-4428-4554.manaNeeded: {4}{G}{W}{U}{U} the first turn, and {G}{U} available each extra turn
252-4312-4428-4554.notablePrerequisites: Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
252-4312-4428-4554.description:
Cast Teferi by paying {4}{W}{U}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature in addition to its other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the counters on Teferi.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Teferi, causing it to enter the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature in addition to its other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Repeat from step 2 each turn.

719-876-1656-4421-4951.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least fifty.
"Angel" or "Cleric" chosen with Xenograft.
719-876-1656-4421-4951.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Priest of Fell Rites.
Activate Priest of Fell Rites by paying three life, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Necrotic Ooze from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Necrotic Ooze enters the battlefield, Righteous Valkyrie's first ability triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Necrotic Ooze's toughness.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Necrotic Ooze.
Activate Necrotic Ooze by paying three life, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Priest of Fell Rites from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Fell Rites enters the battlefield, Righteous Valkyrie's first ability triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Priest of Fell Rites' toughness.
Repeat.

914-4050-5128.notablePrerequisites:
Dockside Extortionist has a sticker on it.
Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-4050-5128.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {B}.
Activate Scampire by paying {3}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1298-3716-4050-4280.description:
Cast Fanning the Flames with buyback by paying {5}{R}{R}.
Veyran and Ovika each trigger twice.
Resolve both Veyran triggers, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve both Ovika triggers, creating eight 1/1 Phyrexian Goblin creature tokens with haste.
Resolve Fanning the Flames, dealing 2 damage to any target and returning Fanning the Flames to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Phyrexian Goblins, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1170-2814-4772.notablePrerequisites: Chandra in hand.You have at least one red instant and/or sorcery in your graveyard.
1170-2814-4772.description:
Cast Chandra by paying {4}{R}{R}, causing it to enter with ten loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Activate Chandra's third loyalty ability by removing seven loyalty counters from it, casting a red instant and/or sorcery from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Chandra, causing it to enter with ten loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Resolve the instant or sorcery spell.
Repeat from step 2.

276-878-3059.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Ziatora triggers, causing you to sacrifice Malignus, deal damage equal to two times Malignus's power to target opponent, and create three Treasure tokens.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1486-1651-1781.description:
Cause Magda to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Magda and another artifact, targeting Magda.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Magda.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3055-3175.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.
